inspiration: Ghidra recursive disassembly/CreateFunctionCmd and AddressTableAnalyzer; AIF fingerprint histogram and PseudoDisassembler.checkValidSubroutine
speed_method: Median wall time for `kuna functions <private> --mode fast --json --option fast_funcdisc VALUE`; off consistently returned 693 canonical entries and omitted 0x402d80, on consistently returned 3495 and included it.
decisions: The old fast preset was not a valid speed baseline because it omitted nearly the entire internal program.
Keep the option default-off because discovery is output-changing and exceeds the per-feature speed budget.
Enable it in fast mode because a project that finishes without real function definitions is incorrect, while the reliable control does not complete.
Use direct-call closure plus conservative pointer roots; keep exhaustive prologue and undefined-gap scans disabled.
Do not recursively expand pointer-derived roots, and bound non-ARM table size and candidate validation.
Explicit address selection suppresses preset discovery unless the caller explicitly forces the option on.
